breakdown.description: A 2D simulation requires the front and back patches to be of type 'empty' to remove their influence, but they are incorrectly set to 'wall', which makes the simulation 3D with frictional side walls.
breakdown.reason: The agent repeated the original error in all three locations: (1) blockMeshDict still uses 'type wall' instead of 'type empty', (2) 0/U still uses 'noSlip' on frontAndBack instead of 'empty', and (3) 0/p still uses 'zeroGradient' on frontAndBack instead of 'empty'. The inconsistency was not resolved.
